layers.text: Recolour only his skin (face, nose, ears, arms, hands, legs and feet): it becomes lightly sun-tanned skin, a light golden tan, colour #dba673 with #b47a4c shadows, clearly lighter than brown. Add war paint: two short bright amber-orange #f08c1e stripes on each cheek and one amber-orange band round his upper arm. Do not redraw anything. Keep the hair, beard, spotted fur, bone club, belt, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
